notablePrerequisites:
Boommobile is a creature.
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Crab Umbra attached to Orthion.
description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Boommobile with haste.
When the Boommobile tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, adding {12}{U}{U}{U}{U}{R}{R}{R}{R} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Orthion.
Repeat.
